label: Ubiquiti Wave MLO5
description: 60 GHz Wave AP with one 10G RJ45 port and one 10G SFP+ port, passive PoE.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking Interface **(1) 10 GbE RJ45 port and (1) 10G SFP+ port**, power method **passive PoE 4-pair or 2-pair, 44-54V DC (2-pair only above 44V)**, 54V 0.56A 10 GbE PoE adapter included, max power consumption 20 W. **Ten-gigabit on both ports** is unusual at this size and means the radio, not the copper, is the bottleneck; the 2-pair PoE mode requires at least 44V, so a 24V passive injector will not bring it up.
